title: Bell's 1964 theorem paper
summary: Bell showed that local hidden-variable theories obey an inequality quantum mechanics can violate.
body: J. S. Bell, "On the Einstein Podolsky Rosen paradox" (Physics Physique Fizika, 1964), derived an inequality that local hidden-variable accounts of the EPR correlations must satisfy, and that quantum mechanics can violate. The paper is a theoretical result. It does not by itself say that a measurement on one particle sends a usable signal to the other. Experiments came later.
